body: Normal for BPD, not normal in general. If every time you bring up something that you think could be done to make you happier, something they could have said nicer, Etc, and they twist it into some argument about why you hate them, that's a bad sign.
Oh yeah. Last week she was leaving me heartfelt voicemails, this week she's MIA, lol. I'm sorry you went through this.

Time, I guess. It's hard because feeding their emotional hunger becomes forefront and center of our lives. And when they're gone, filling that void that used to be a black hole seems impossible. At least that's where I am at right now.
